title: VehicleStateResponse
description: Schema for the single vehicle state API response

position.description: Position along the current lane in meters

speed.description: Speed of the vehicle in meters per second

acceleration.description: Current acceleration of the vehicle in m/s^2

x.description: X coordinate of the vehicle center

y.description: Y coordinate of the vehicle center

heading.description: Compass heading of the vehicle in degrees

lane_id.description: Identifier of the current lane the vehicle is on
